reviewDecisions.rationale: The national strategic state is very large but near-term property/construction activity is explicitly controlled; deep research must test whether any listed company has a real early earnings bridge rather than theme association.

Observable shutdowns create a fresh upstream state before full downstream flow confirmation; deep research should test compliant/cost-advantaged company paths without requiring immediate aggregate confirmation.
Physical demand is exceptionally strong but the rebound has already lasted several months; company earnings/cash and price absorption should determine residual opportunity.

Index inclusion is a real structural accessibility change, but actual implementation is delayed and initial weight is small; deep research should distinguish durable company beneficiaries from generic concept chasing.
Global DRAM scarcity is strongly confirmed; deep research must fail closed unless a direct current A-share supplier earnings bridge exists.

Spot D3 pricing and the obvious listed exposure have already surged; deep research should test whether realized earnings and supply structure justify continuation rather than extrapolating a speculative spike.
